description: This Java source file defines the 'EnterpriseApplication' class, which boots an embedded Jetty server, configures it to serve a packaged web application from the classpath, and manages server startup and shutdown procedures.

classes.name: EnterpriseApplication
classes.description: Main class for bootstrapping and managing the embedded Jetty web server, serving resources from a packaged web application.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Application entry point that sets up and starts the embedded Jetty server with a webapp loaded from the classpath.

methods.name: resolvePort
methods.description: Determines the port for Jetty to listen on, based on system properties or defaults to 8090.
